_instructions: Road-plane calibration for vehicle speed estimation. Click A(top-left) B(top-right) C(bottom-right) D(bottom-left) on a real frame to map image pixels to world ground metres. width_m = A->B (road width), depth_m = A->D (distance ahead). Enabled only when configured=true. See SPEED_ESTIMATION.md.
note: SPEED N/A - CALIBRATION REQUIRED. Click CALIBRATE SPEED to map 4 road points to known world dimensions.
